10 flows, 54 emails, all live, measured against the build scope in your account plan. One square per email, and the figure on the right is what the flow earned in the last 30 days.

blocks.title: What the build is producing

blocks.html:
Where we’d like to point it next

The build has done its job: 54 emails across 10 flows, and in Aug ’26 they returned A$8,398 against A$120 in Apr ’26. They keep running whether or not anything else gets built.

The A$1,000 a month behind it finishes on 1 October 2026, and we’d rather keep it pointed at two things than end it: the weekly campaigns, where every send has returned A$413 across 13 sends, and the rest of the build at half strength.

What’s live is the core, 11 of the 18 flows in our framework. Next is the advanced set: Prospect Nurture, Birthday Capture, Birthday Gift Delivery, VIP Welcome, VIP Winback, Evergreen Best of the Best and Evergreen Primer. Same money, the full system instead of the first pass.
